# Microsoft WebView2 SDK / 微软窗口组件

Pinned SDK: **1.0.4258.31**, from the official Microsoft NuGet package. The SHA-256 of the downloaded package and every redistributed SDK file are recorded in manifest.json. Microsoft Authenticode signature was verified locally. Unmodified .NET Framework Core/WinForms assemblies and x86/x64/ARM64 native loaders are included; WPF, symbols, XML docs and the browser runtime are omitted.

固定使用微软官方 NuGet SDK 1.0.4258.31。manifest.json 保存原始包与所分发文件的 SHA-256，已检查微软数字签名。仅包含未经修改的 Core、WinForms 和三种架构加载器，不打包完整浏览器。

Redistribution terms: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). These files retain Microsoft's license and are not covered by Luna's MIT license. The separate Evergreen WebView2 Runtime must be installed on the computer. [Microsoft distribution guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/distribution).

分发遵循随附微软许可证。电脑另需安装 Evergreen WebView2 Runtime；构建不自动下载、安装或更新任何组件。
